sprints.title: Repository Bootstrap
sprints.goal: Create the greenfield repository/solution structure so backend, desktop shell, frontend, tests, and docs build from one checkout.
tests: Frontend unit smoke test and production build pass.
acceptance: One checkout can build backend + frontend.
Desktop shell opens the React surface.
No business feature is implemented yet.
tasks: Create `DocumentIDE.sln` and projects for Core, Infrastructure, Api, Desktop, ShareHost, and tests.
Create `src/DocumentIDE.Web` using React + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind.
Wire WebView2 desktop shell to a development URL and a production static-asset mode.
Add formatting/linting/editorconfig and deterministic restore commands.
Add backend/frontend smoke tests and a repository-level verification script.

sprints.title: Privileged Local API Security
sprints.goal: Protect the loopback privileged API from foreign browser origins and unauthenticated localhost requests.
acceptance: Loopback alone is never treated as authentication.
Secret is not persisted to disk/localStorage.
Security middleware runs before privileged controllers.
tasks: Bind the privileged API to loopback on a runtime-selected port.
Generate a 256-bit per-startup session secret in native host memory.
Implement strict Host + dedicated WebView2 Origin validation and reject `Origin: null`.
Require the startup secret on every privileged request through a native/WebView request bridge.
Disallow wildcard CORS and state-changing GET endpoints.

sprints.title: SQLite Persistence Foundation
sprints.goal: Create the authoritative application metadata database, migrations, repositories, and concurrency baseline.
tests: FTS-like read can continue during unrelated short write transaction.
acceptance: Database lives under application-controlled local state.
No document contents become source-of-truth database blobs.
WAL is verified at runtime.
tasks: Create migration runner and initial tables for Workspace, FolderSource, Document, and WorkspaceDocument.
Create transaction/repository abstractions with short write transactions.
Add database versioning and startup migration flow.
Add integration tests for concurrent reader/writer behavior.

sprints.title: Background Job Runtime
sprints.goal: Provide cancellable, deduplicated, bounded background jobs for indexing, previews, exports, reconciliation, and other expensive work.
tests: Cancellation stops before the next safe boundary.
Two mutation jobs for the same document never execute concurrently.
acceptance: UI thread is not used for expensive jobs.
Retry is limited to safe/idempotent jobs.
Failures expose typed diagnostics.
tasks: Define job identity, type, state, progress, cancellation, and retry contract.
Implement bounded worker queues with per-document serialization support.
Implement deduplication by job type + document + fingerprint.
Persist/recover only job state that materially needs crash recovery.
Expose observable progress to local UI.

sprints.title: Settings & Secret Storage
sprints.goal: Persist non-sensitive settings and protect ngrok/external-AI secrets using Windows-protected storage.
tests: Secret can be stored/read by current user context.
Secret never appears in structured logs.
acceptance: No plaintext long-lived API/ngrok credential in app database.
Startup session secret is not persisted here.
tasks: Create typed settings model with defaults from specs.
Separate secret references from normal SQLite settings.
Ensure logs and exception messages redact secrets.

sprints.title: Structured Logging & Diagnostics
sprints.goal: Add local structured diagnostics that help debug indexing, Word, filesystem, batch, and share failures without leaking document contents.
tests: Batch operation can be traced by correlation ID.
Log rotation does not delete source/history data.
acceptance: Logs are local only.
No arbitrary document body logging.
Errors retain document ID/path only where appropriate in privileged local logs.
tasks: Define event IDs/categories for core subsystems.
Redact tokens, API keys, and full document bodies.
Add correlation IDs for jobs and batch operations.
Add an owner-only diagnostics export that excludes source documents by default.

sprints.title: Desktop/WebView Production Host
sprints.goal: Make the WPF + WebView2 application run the production React bundle and local privileged API without terminal processes.
tests: Production build opens without Vite dev server.
Foreign navigation loses privileged bridge capability.
Closing desktop stops privileged local host cleanly.
acceptance: User launches one Windows app.
React static assets are local in production.
WebView origin remains deterministic for Origin validation.
tasks: Host the built React bundle via a dedicated application origin/virtual host mapping.
Start/stop privileged local backend with desktop lifecycle.
Inject runtime API endpoint/session authorization through native bridge.
Implement development Vite URL mode and production static mode.
Handle WebView2 missing/runtime failure with a useful local error.

sprints.title: Build, Verify & Artifact Scripts
sprints.goal: Create repeatable developer and release commands that agents can run from VS Code/PowerShell.
tests: Fresh clone bootstrap succeeds with prerequisites installed.
Verify script returns nonzero on failing test.
Release build embeds production web assets.
acceptance: One command verifies repository health.
No manual copy of frontend assets required.
tasks: Make frontend build feed desktop publish automatically.
Document Windows prerequisites and VS Code launch tasks.

sprints.title: Folder Source Attachment
sprints.goal: Let a workspace attach one or more local folders without importing/copying documents.
tests: Reject nonexistent/inaccessible path with typed error.
acceptance: No `.documentide` metadata is written into source folder.
Attaching a folder does not mutate contents.
tasks: Enumerate supported `.docx`/`.md` documents recursively with containment rules.
Expose supported file count to UI.

sprints.title: Stable Document Identity
sprints.goal: Track physical documents by stable application identity rather than mutable path.
tests: Two distinct duplicate files receive distinct DocumentIds.
Path casing change does not duplicate record.
acceptance: Path is an attribute, never identity.
Ambiguous duplicate content is not auto-merged.
tasks: Implement `DocumentId` creation and Windows volume/file-ID probe.
Persist current path, last-known path, size, mtime, fingerprint.
Resolve a filesystem object to existing/new Document record.
Add fallback identity evidence structure for non-NTFS cases.

sprints.title: Runtime File Watcher
sprints.goal: Detect external create/modify/rename/delete changes while the app runs and convert noisy events into verified logical changes.
tests: One Word-like burst becomes one logical modification.
Duplicate events do not duplicate Document records.
acceptance: Watcher events are hints only.
Expensive parse does not happen inside raw watcher callback.
tasks: Verify final filesystem state before emitting logical event.
Trigger reconciliation fallback on watcher overflow.

sprints.title: Hybrid Startup Reconciliation
sprints.goal: Show cached workspace immediately, then reconcile all configured sources against disk and queue only changed documents.
tests: Changes made while app was closed are detected.
Cached canvas appears before reconciliation completes.
acceptance: Filesystem wins over stale cache.
Reconciliation never rewrites source files.
tasks: Load cached workspace presentation before deep scan.
Queue deep work only for stale/new files.
Expose temporary verification state to UI without blocking interaction.

sprints.title: Rename & Move Correlation
sprints.goal: Preserve DocumentId/workspace metadata through rename and move while refusing ambiguous cross-volume auto-correlation.
tests: Two identical candidate copies require confirmation.
App-originated move correlates watcher delete/create sequence.
acceptance: Identical content does not automatically mean same identity.
No silent merge of ambiguous records.
tasks: Add short-lived operation journal for app-originated physical moves.
Implement cross-volume candidate scoring by fingerprint/name/size/mtime.
Expose confirmation flow for ambiguous rebind.

sprints.title: Missing File & Folder Recovery
sprints.goal: Keep missing documents/sources visible with last-known metadata and explicit locate/remove actions.
tests: Locate same file rebinds prior DocumentId.
Remove reference never deletes physical file.
acceptance: Permission-denied is distinct from missing.
Unavailable drive does not destroy workspace layout.
tasks: Persist missing state instead of deleting workspace metadata.
Implement Locate file/source with identity/fingerprint verification.
Implement Remove reference without deleting physical data.
Restore prior canvas/group state after successful locate.

sprints.title: Explicit Physical File Operations
sprints.goal: Implement safe explicit rename, move, duplicate, create-folder/create-file, and Recycle-Bin delete operations.
tests: Rename rejects separators, `..`, rooted path, reserved names, ADS syntax.
Canvas drag code path never calls this service.
acceptance: No arbitrary path write endpoint.
Destination collision is explicit.
tasks: Implement explicit `MovePhysicalFile` separate from canvas movement.
Implement duplicate/create folder/create Markdown and template-DOCX hooks.
Journal app-originated operations for watcher correlation.

sprints.title: Reparse Point & Source Containment
sprints.goal: Prevent source traversal/index/share/batch operations from escaping configured roots through junctions or symlinks.
tests: Escaping junction is not included in batch scope.
Escaping junction content cannot enter Share artifacts.
acceptance: No silent traversal outside explicit root.
Error is inspectable rather than crashing scan.
tasks: Detect Windows reparse points during traversal.
Resolve canonical targets and verify containment.
Share common root-containment validator across indexing, batch scope, and share preparation.
Add regression fixture linking source path to an outside secret directory.

sprints.title: DOCX Package Resource Preflight
sprints.goal: Reject hostile/oversized DOCX ZIP/XML packages before deep OpenXML parsing.
tests: Highly compressed hostile fixture does not exhaust process.
acceptance: Source remains untouched.
Rejected file remains visible with indexing warning.
tasks: Inspect compressed size, ZIP entry count, declared uncompressed sizes, and per-part size.
Prohibit DTD/external entity behavior in XML readers.
Benchmark/decide whether hostile parsing needs worker-process isolation.

sprints.title: DOCX Structural Parser
sprints.goal: Extract searchable text and document structure from safe DOCX packages without modifying them.
tests: No-op parse leaves byte fingerprint unchanged.
acceptance: Field instructions are not treated as ordinary destructive text.
Malformed package gives typed error.
tasks: Parse body paragraphs, tables, headers, footers, sections, and relationships needed by metadata.
Extract structured text without raw XML search hacks.

sprints.title: Markdown Structural Parser
sprints.goal: Parse Markdown headings, frontmatter, links, wikilinks, and searchable body while preserving source text.
tests: Malformed frontmatter does not destroy body indexing.
acceptance: Parser never rewrites Markdown.
Ambiguous link resolution is deferred to relation service.
tasks: Parse YAML frontmatter into structured metadata.
Preserve raw source separately from derived parse result.

sprints.title: Metadata Persistence
sprints.goal: Persist derived DOCX/Markdown metadata and expose a stable query model to inspector/search.
tests: Parser version mismatch marks derived data rebuildable.
acceptance: Derived metadata can be deleted/rebuilt.
Null means not applicable, not fabricated defaults.
tasks: Expose metadata DTOs without source binary data.

sprints.title: FTS5 Search Index
sprints.goal: Create the persistent local FTS5 index for filename/body/headings/tables/headers/footers/frontmatter.
tests: Exact token lookup returns expected document.
Deleting/rebuilding index does not touch source files.
Concurrent search while update remains responsive.
acceptance: No external search server.
Index is rebuildable from source.
tasks: Create FTS5 migration and content synchronization API.

sprints.title: Incremental Index Scheduler
sprints.goal: Connect filesystem changes to minimal parse/index/cache invalidation work.
tests: One modified file reindexes only itself.
Repeated event for same fingerprint does not duplicate work.
Deleted file is removed from active index but retained as missing metadata.
acceptance: No DB writer transaction wraps expensive parsing.
Index failure does not break other search results.
tasks: Map verified file changes to parse jobs.
Skip deep parse when fingerprint unchanged.
Invalidate relevant metadata/preview/embedding cache when changed.

sprints.title: Structured Query Parser
sprints.goal: Parse user search syntax into a typed query instead of ad-hoc SQL/string logic.
acceptance: Parser output is independent from storage query language.
tasks: Parse terms, quoted phrases, exclusions, filters, scope, and mode.
Return syntax diagnostics for malformed filters.
Add escaping tests against SQL/FTS syntax injection.

sprints.title: Exact Ranked Search
sprints.goal: Provide real-time lexical search with deterministic ranking and origin-aware snippets.
tests: Search only returns documents in requested scope.
acceptance: No semantic matching in exact mode.
No reparse on keystroke.
tasks: Rank exact filename > filename partial > heading > body > table > header/footer.
Enforce explicit document scope at backend.

sprints.title: Metadata Filters
sprints.goal: Make derived document metadata queryable and clickable as search filters.
tests: Inspector click produces equivalent filter query.
acceptance: Metadata filter never mutates documents.
tasks: Expose metadata filter chips/counts to frontend.
Allow inspector metadata click to build query.

sprints.title: Fuzzy Exploratory Search
sprints.goal: Add typo-tolerant exploratory matching while keeping exact results higher and destructive operations isolated.
tests: Batch/SearchReplace module has no dependency on fuzzy matcher.
acceptance: Fuzzy never becomes implicit destructive matching.
tasks: Choose/implement bounded fuzzy matcher suitable for <1,000 docs.
Blend fuzzy score below exact lexical score.
Cap candidate set before expensive distance scoring.

sprints.title: Realtime Search UI & Selection
sprints.goal: Integrate indexed search into the workspace without destroying canvas positions and allow results to become a batch target.
tests: Search UI updates without page navigation.
Exit search restores exact canvas state.
Selected result IDs match backend result set.
acceptance: Search never reflows persisted canvas coordinates.
tasks: Highlight/fade canvas objects without persisting layout changes.
Preserve search scope when invoking batch operations.

sprints.title: Canvas Foundation
sprints.goal: Build the clean white spatial workspace with pan/zoom, persisted viewport, and object-layer architecture.
tests: 100 objects can render/pan smoothly in baseline test.
No dashboard cards appear in default canvas.
acceptance: Canvas state is workspace metadata only.
tasks: Implement canvas viewport and transform state.
Render minimal white surface and selection layer.
Select canvas/graph library only after recorded spike benchmark.

sprints.title: Folder Canvas Object
sprints.goal: Represent each attached physical folder as a simple folder object with name and supported-file count.
acceptance: Folder object does not contain/import file bytes.

sprints.title: Document Paper Object & Thumbnail Shell
sprints.goal: Render DOCX/Markdown as paper-sheet objects with exact filename and cached low-detail preview.
tests: Filename is readable at normal zoom.
Thumbnail failure falls back without breaking canvas.
acceptance: Thumbnail is derived/cache data only.
tasks: Use recognizable but intentionally low-detail document image.

sprints.title: Folder Picker & File Release
sprints.goal: Implement single-click folder picker, multi-select, Open Selected, and double-click Open All behavior.
tests: Single click does not dump all files.
Double click opens all supported files.
Open Selected releases only selected DocumentIds.
acceptance: No physical move occurs.
tasks: Open lightweight picker on single click.
List supported folder contents and allow multi-select.
Create/activate WorkspaceDocument objects without physical file movement.

sprints.title: Spatially Indexed Assisted Placement
sprints.goal: Place newly released documents near origin using local collision avoidance without O(n²) full-canvas scanning.
tests: Placement uses nearby candidates instead of full scan.
acceptance: No global reshuffle on local insert.
tasks: Implement spatial hash/grid, R-tree, or quadtree selected by benchmark.
Insert/update object bounds in spatial index.
Find candidate positions near source folder.
Perform only local reflow of eligible auto objects.

sprints.title: Position Persistence & Pinning
sprints.goal: Persist auto/manual/pinned positions and preserve spatial memory across restart, rename, and reconciliation.
tests: Pinned node never moves during local reflow.
acceptance: Canvas coordinates remain independent from filesystem paths.
tasks: Persist WorkspaceDocument position mode and coordinates.
Switch to manual after user drag.
Resolve occupied restore location with nearest-safe fallback.

sprints.title: Multi-Select, Group Drag & Tidy
sprints.goal: Provide selection rectangle, Ctrl-select, group drag, Tidy Selection, and Tidy Canvas while respecting pins/spatial regions.
tests: Tidy selection stays in approximate region.
acceptance: Tidy is organizational only; no filesystem mutation.
tasks: Preserve relative positions for existing multi-drag.
Implement Tidy Canvas for unpinned objects.
Use spatial index for collision resolution.

sprints.title: List View & View Switch
sprints.goal: Add Canvas | List | Graph switch foundation and a dense List view for sorting/filtering/bulk selection.
tests: Switching view does not lose workspace.
List selection can feed existing selection model.
acceptance: List is another view of same DocumentIds, not imported copies.
tasks: Implement List view columns for key metadata.
Keep graph placeholder routed for later sprint.

sprints.title: Logical DOCX Text/Run Map
sprints.goal: Create a logical text model that maps visible paragraph ranges back to OOXML runs/text nodes.
acceptance: No source mutation in mapping stage.
tasks: Map logical character offsets to package part/paragraph/run/text node.
Handle preserved spaces and split runs.
Exclude unsafe field instruction text by default.

sprints.title: Logical Search Across Runs
sprints.goal: Find deterministic exact text matches even when Word splits visible text across OOXML runs.
tests: `NUSA-DUA-1` split across runs is one match.
Repeated text yields stable occurrence IDs.
acceptance: No fuzzy/semantic dependency.
tasks: Return structural references for every match.
Exclude field instructions unless explicitly supported.
Return preview context around each match.

sprints.title: Strict DOCX Text Mutation
sprints.goal: Replace a selected logical match while changing the minimum OOXML text structures and preserving unrelated formatting.
tests: Split-run replacement produces correct visible text.
acceptance: Never raw-string replace XML.
No whole-document HTML regeneration.
tasks: Copy working DOCX to temp fixture.
Remove only safely redundant emptied text/run structures.

sprints.title: Document Lens Metadata
sprints.goal: Expose useful DOCX structure and format metadata without opening Word.
tests: Metadata click can invoke search filter where supported.
acceptance: Derived heuristic is labeled as summary, not source fact.
tasks: Expose heading list and header/footer presence.

sprints.title: Open DOCX in Microsoft Word
sprints.goal: Open the original local DOCX in Microsoft Word Desktop from double-click/context action.
tests: Open action does not alter source fingerprint.
acceptance: Word is external window, never embedded.
tasks: Resolve DocumentId to canonical available path.
Open original document in Word using adapter/shell.
Handle Word missing with typed feature-unavailable UI.
Do not create an editable proprietary copy.

sprints.title: Word Editing/Lock Detection
sprints.goal: Detect likely Word editing state and block unsafe app-originated mutation of open/changed DOCX files.
tests: Open Word doc shows editing state.
Batch preflight can block/skip open doc.
acceptance: No single heuristic is treated as infallible.
tasks: Combine Word document-list probe, lock/access signal, and Word temp-file hints.
Refresh state on relevant filesystem/process changes.

sprints.title: Dedicated STA Word Automation Queue
sprints.goal: Serialize all Word COM automation on one dedicated STA worker with concurrency exactly one.
tests: No repeated orphan Word process in integration run.
acceptance: Indexing/OpenXML remains independently concurrent.
tasks: Create dedicated STA worker thread/process boundary for Word automation adapter.
Implement cancellation between documents, not mid-unsafe COM write.

sprints.title: High-Fidelity Quick Look
sprints.goal: Provide Space/Preview read-only multi-page Quick Look using lazy Word-rendered PDF/image artifacts.
tests: Public viewer does not directly call Word queue.
acceptance: No eager Word render for all files at startup.
tasks: Define preview cache key by DocumentId/fingerprint/renderer version.
Render pages for Quick Look and cache safely.

sprints.title: Batch Operation Plan Domain
sprints.goal: Define typed previewable operation plans with file fingerprints, occurrence/change IDs, lifecycle, and idempotency.
tests: Plan records expected fingerprint per file.
acceptance: Apply endpoint references reviewed plan, not arbitrary mutation payload.
tasks: Store expected fingerprint and selected change IDs.
Disallow apply parameters that were not previewed.

sprints.title: Batch Scope Resolver
sprints.goal: Resolve Selection/Folder/Workspace/Collection scopes deterministically with recursive folder inclusion and branch exclusions.
tests: Folder scope recursively includes nested files.
acceptance: Containment policy from FS-08 is reused.
tasks: Implement Selection scope by explicit DocumentIds.
Implement Folder scope with subfolders ON by default.
Return scanned file counts before content matching.

sprints.title: Batch Preview API & Review Shell
sprints.goal: Create preview API/UI that shows blast radius before any destructive change.
tests: Apply button is unavailable until preview completes.
acceptance: No direct destructive 'Replace All' path bypasses plan.
tasks: Add preview endpoint and progress job.

sprints.title: Recovery Snapshot Storage
sprints.goal: Create 30-day per-operation snapshots with 5 GiB budget, 80% warning, and fail-closed capacity preflight.
acceptance: Retention target remains 30 days.
Failure to snapshot means failure to mutate.
tasks: Copy only files affected by approved operation.
Warn at 80% and block destructive apply if complete snapshots cannot fit.
Clean only expired snapshots unless owner explicitly clears history.

sprints.title: Transactional Safe Apply Engine
sprints.goal: Apply a reviewed operation plan with stale/lock checks, recovery snapshot, temp mutation, validation, and atomic replace.
tests: Injected mutation failure leaves original unchanged.
Open Word doc is safely skipped/blocked.
acceptance: Cancellation never leaves half-written original.
tasks: Verify current fingerprint equals preview fingerprint.
Copy original to same-volume temp, mutate temp, validate, atomically replace.
Record per-file success/skipped/failure and trigger reindex.

sprints.title: Exact Search & Replace Operation
sprints.goal: Implement deterministic exact Search & Replace over DOCX logical body/table/header/footer text and Markdown text.
acceptance: Default matching is exact/deterministic.
tasks: Build DOCX logical matches across runs.

sprints.title: Occurrence Review UX
sprints.goal: Make per-occurrence inclusion/exclusion practical across many files before apply.
acceptance: Review UI never expands scope itself.
tasks: Group matches by file and origin.
Provide context snippet and old→new preview.

sprints.title: Regex Advanced Replace
sprints.goal: Add opt-in regex Search & Replace with deterministic preview, timeout, and bounded execution.
acceptance: Regex never bypasses preview.
tasks: Compile regex with timeout/non-backtracking option where compatible.

sprints.title: Strict Font & Font-Size Operations
sprints.goal: Change only requested font family or size on reviewed DOCX targets without changing unrelated paragraph/page formatting.
tests: Mixed formatting preview identifies affected text.
acceptance: No normalize-to-template behavior.
tasks: Define explicit font operation target semantics.

sprints.title: Strict Page-Layout Operations
sprints.goal: Implement margins, paper size, orientation, and paragraph alignment as independent strict operations.
tests: A4 operation does not alter margins.
Margin operation does not alter font.
Alignment operation does not alter section properties.
acceptance: Every operation has separate type/preview semantics.
tasks: Implement SetAlignment only on targeted paragraphs.

sprints.title: Strict Batch Rename
sprints.goal: Batch-rename files using basename-only reviewed plans and the explicit physical-operation service.
tests: Internal batch target collisions are detected before apply.
acceptance: Rename cannot become move.
tasks: Generate old/new basename preview for every file.
Validate every target using FS-07 basename rules.
Detect collisions across the batch before changing first file.

sprints.title: Conflict-Aware Undo
sprints.goal: Undo completed operations from snapshots only when current files have not changed incompatibly since the operation.
tests: Externally edited file is not blindly overwritten.
acceptance: Undo uses same safe-write discipline.
tasks: Compare current fingerprint with post-operation fingerprint.
Mark conflict when externally edited later.
Record undone status and trigger reindex.

sprints.title: Batch Results & History UI
sprints.goal: Provide inspectable operation history, per-file outcomes, storage status, and retry/review navigation.
tests: History usage warning appears at threshold.
acceptance: UI never claims complete success for partial operation.
tasks: Link failures back to affected documents.

sprints.title: Source-First Markdown Editor
sprints.goal: Open `.md` internally with Edit/Preview/Split shell while the physical Markdown file remains authoritative.
tests: Editor never creates proprietary hidden source.
acceptance: External changes are reconciled.

sprints.title: Markdown Preview & Sanitization
sprints.goal: Render Markdown, code, tables, tasks, Mermaid, and math safely without arbitrary script/code execution.
tests: Preview cannot read arbitrary local file.
acceptance: Sanitization also reusable by Share viewer.
tasks: Add code syntax highlighting, tables/tasks, Mermaid, and math.
Disable arbitrary code-fence execution and unsafe HTML/script behavior.

sprints.title: Frontmatter & Explicit Link Index
sprints.goal: Persist Markdown frontmatter and explicit relative-link/wikilink relation candidates after each save.
tests: Relative link target resolves when unique.
acceptance: Derived relations never rewrite Markdown automatically.
tasks: Normalize relative links against physical path.
Update derived link index on save/reindex.
Do not mutate source to normalize metadata.

sprints.title: Wikilink Resolution & Backlink Inputs
sprints.goal: Resolve `[[wikilinks]]` deterministically and surface ambiguity rather than silently picking a duplicate filename.
acceptance: No silent arbitrary candidate choice.
tasks: Return ambiguity list when multiple candidates.

sprints.title: Relation Store & Extraction
sprints.goal: Persist explicit/manual/semantic relation records with origin/type/confidence separated.
acceptance: Semantic relation cannot masquerade as explicit.
tasks: Track relation origin separately from type.
Remove stale derived relations after reparse.

sprints.title: Backlinks & Reference Inspector
sprints.goal: Expose References, Referenced By, and Potentially Related sections using relation store.
tests: Explicit and inferred sections are separate.
Missing target is shown without crash.
acceptance: Backlinks are deterministic.
tasks: Reserve separate section for inferred relations.

sprints.title: Graph View
sprints.goal: Implement the Graph main view with independent persisted node coordinates and truthful edge styling.
tests: Moving graph node does not move canvas node.
acceptance: Graph is a view, not source-of-truth relation store.
tasks: Persist GraphNodeState separately from canvas coordinates.
Render solid explicit edges and reserved dashed semantic style.

sprints.title: Manual Relations
sprints.goal: Allow owner to create/edit/delete explicit workspace-level manual relations without modifying Markdown source.
tests: Deleting manual relation does not edit Markdown.
acceptance: No automatic source insertion.
tasks: Select relation type from controlled vocabulary.

sprints.title: Bounded Graph Rendering
sprints.goal: Keep graph usable for large workspaces through neighborhood/filter default, top-K semantic edges, and off-UI-thread layout.
tests: Large graph does not freeze UI.
Default mode is bounded above threshold.
Full graph remains explicit user action.
acceptance: No all-to-all semantic rendering.
tasks: Move layout computation off interactive UI thread/worker.
Default >250 visible nodes to selected-neighborhood/filter mode.
Prepare API for top-K semantic edges (`K=5` default).

sprints.title: Embedding Provider Abstraction
sprints.goal: Define local-first semantic provider contracts without coupling core search/graph to a specific model or external API.
tests: Core exact search works with no provider configured.
acceptance: External AI is optional.
tasks: Define EmbeddingProvider interface and model identity.
Define optional external provider boundary with explicit opt-in.

sprints.title: Local Embedding Provider
sprints.goal: Implement a local embedding model path suitable for under-1,000-document workspaces.
tests: Resource use is bounded during batch embedding.
acceptance: No source document leaves machine.
tasks: Bundle/download model according to explicit packaging policy.

sprints.title: Semantic Search Mode
sprints.goal: Add clearly labeled semantic search as an optional exploratory mode independent from Exact.
tests: Semantic mode finds conceptually related fixture.
SearchReplace does not depend on semantic service.
acceptance: No invisible semantic contamination of destructive actions.
tasks: Implement semantic query embedding and nearest-neighbor lookup.
Keep Exact mode deterministic and unchanged.

sprints.title: Semantic Graph Suggestions
sprints.goal: Generate inferred graph edges with top-K/confidence limits and dashed truthful presentation.
tests: No document gets >K default semantic edges.
acceptance: Semantic edge is never treated as explicit dependency.
tasks: Compute top-K (`K=5` default) neighbors per document.

sprints.title: Context Pack Core
sprints.goal: Create a deterministic context pack from explicit selected/collection documents for AI coding-agent use.
tests: No implicit semantic expansion by default.
acceptance: Context pack generation does not modify source files.
tasks: Represent Markdown sources with source headings.
Store pack definition as workspace metadata if saved.

sprints.title: Explicit Dependency Expansion
sprints.goal: Optionally expand a context pack using explicit backlinks/dependencies while remaining deterministic and bounded.
tests: Semantic edge is not traversed by default.
acceptance: No hidden infinite graph expansion.
tasks: Traverse only explicit relation origins by default.

sprints.title: DOCX Context Representation
sprints.goal: Include DOCX in context packs through extracted structured text/Markdown-like representation without modifying DOCX.
acceptance: Representation is derived, not round-tripped back to DOCX.
tasks: Convert headings/paragraphs/tables into stable Markdown-like text.

sprints.title: Token Estimate & Context Export
sprints.goal: Estimate context size and export/copy an agent-ready `context.md`.
tests: Token estimate is labeled by tokenizer/model.
acceptance: No external AI call required.
tasks: Export combined `context.md` using safe file write.
Warn when target budget is exceeded.

sprints.title: Single DOCX PDF Export
sprints.goal: Export one DOCX to PDF through the serialized Word automation queue without modifying source.
tests: Existing PDF is not silently overwritten.
acceptance: Word COM only via queue.

sprints.title: Batch Separate PDF Export
sprints.goal: Export multiple DOCX files as separate PDFs with progress, cancellation between files, and partial results.
acceptance: Completed outputs are not deleted on unrelated later failure.

sprints.title: Streaming Ordered PDF Merge
sprints.goal: Merge user-ordered PDFs using sequential file/stream processing without rasterization or loading the whole corpus into RAM.
tests: Output page order matches user order.
Peak memory does not scale linearly with total source bytes.
acceptance: No silent inferred merge order.
tasks: Append inputs sequentially with bounded buffers.
Clean temp job directory on success/failure.

sprints.title: PDF Finalization UX
sprints.goal: Expose single/batch/merge PDF finalization coherently from selection, inspector, command palette, and error results.
tests: One selected DOCX defaults to single export.
acceptance: PDF remains output-only.

sprints.title: Share Domain & Sanitized Manifest
sprints.goal: Define explicit share membership, Snapshot/Live modes, permissions, and a sanitized artifact manifest independent from local paths.
tests: New Collection member does not auto-enter existing share.
Manifest contains only explicit member IDs.
Manifest payload has no physical path.
acceptance: Live mode does not imply live membership.
tasks: Snapshot explicit membership at creation including collection-derived shares.
Never store/expose physical paths in public manifest.

sprints.title: Separate ShareHost Process
sprints.goal: Create `DocumentIDE.ShareHost.exe` that serves only share manifests/artifacts and does not reference privileged mutation/Word services.
tests: Dependency test fails if privileged service assembly/interface is referenced.
Arbitrary local path route does not exist.
acceptance: Process separation is documented as risk reduction, not full sandbox.
tasks: Give it a narrow dependency graph.
Exclude Word, batch mutation, unrestricted filesystem service references.
Bind viewer server to loopback for ngrok exposure.

sprints.title: Share Token Authentication
sprints.goal: Protect each public share with a fixed-format 256-bit secret token stored as hash and verified in fixed time.
tests: Token A cannot access Share B.
Malformed long token is rejected cheaply.
acceptance: Ngrok URL alone is not authorization.
tasks: Generate 32 CSPRNG bytes and base64url encoding.
Reject malformed/oversized token before expensive lookup.
Scope resolved ShareId before any document access.

sprints.title: Snapshot Share
sprints.goal: Publish a frozen read-only share package containing only explicit member artifacts as they existed at publication time.
tests: Later local edit does not change Snapshot.
acceptance: Original download absent unless permission later enables it.

sprints.title: Membership-Safe Live Share
sprints.goal: Refresh content only for existing share members while requiring explicit owner action for membership changes.
tests: New file in shared folder is not public.
Collection membership change does not auto-publish.
Existing member update appears after refresh.
acceptance: Live content ≠ live membership.
tasks: Subscribe owner process to changes for current ShareMember set.
Refresh artifacts after saved member file changes.
Do not react to new files as new public members.
Add explicit Add/Remove member owner operation.

sprints.title: Share-Scoped Search & Graph
sprints.goal: Allow public viewer search/graph only over explicit share membership, never whole workspace then UI-filtered.
tests: Graph omits edge to private node.
acceptance: Scope enforcement is server-side.
tasks: Enforce ShareMember constraint in backend query.
Filter graph to both endpoints being members.

sprints.title: Share Download Permissions
sprints.goal: Implement original/PDF download permissions defaulting OFF and enforced server-side.
acceptance: UI hiding is not the enforcement boundary.
tasks: Add permission fields to owner UI/domain.
Prepare original/PDF artifact only as policy requires.

sprints.title: Share CSP, Sanitization & Rate Limits
sprints.goal: Harden the public viewer with strict CSP, HTML sanitization, and concrete endpoint/concurrency rate limits.
acceptance: Public request cannot trigger Word COM.
tasks: Reuse maintained sanitizer for rendered Markdown.
Configure general 120/min/IP, search 30/min/IP, download 10/min/IP, concurrent download 2/IP defaults.

sprints.title: ngrok Transport
sprints.goal: Expose ShareHost through ngrok using an adapter owned by the desktop app and a user-configured protected credential.
acceptance: Provider logic stays isolated.
tasks: Build final public URL + secret path.

sprints.title: ShareHost OS Isolation Spike
sprints.goal: Evaluate practical Windows OS-level isolation so process separation is not falsely described as a sandbox.
tests: Docs do not claim sandboxing unless test proves it.
Chosen restriction still permits required share artifact reads/network.
acceptance: If strong isolation is not feasible V1, residual risk remains explicit.
tasks: Prototype restricted token/AppContainer or equivalent supported mechanism.
Prototype ACL-limited access to share artifact root.
Test what user filesystem paths remain readable after simulated compromise.
Record ADR choosing V1 isolation posture and exact residual risk.

sprints.title: Owner Share Management UI
sprints.goal: Give owner explicit create/copy/status/manage-members/permissions/revoke controls for Snapshot and Live shares.
acceptance: No hidden automatic publishing.

sprints.title: Golden DOCX Regression Corpus
sprints.goal: Build the canonical fixture corpus and structural invariance tests for DOCX safety.
acceptance: Corpus is version controlled and deterministic.
tasks: Create helper assertions for package validity and unrelated-property invariance.

sprints.title: Filesystem & Indexing Soak
sprints.goal: Exercise watcher/reconciliation/indexing over long sessions with Word-like save bursts and filesystem churn.
acceptance: Failures produce reproducible logs.
tasks: Measure duplicate jobs/DocumentIds and memory growth.

sprints.title: Privileged Local API Security Audit
sprints.goal: Prove localhost API cannot be driven by foreign browser origin, Host mismatch, or missing session authorization.
tests: All hostile cases rejected before controller.
acceptance: Release gate blocks on failure.
tasks: Test CORS policy and state-changing-method rules.
Run browser-based attack page fixture against live test host.

sprints.title: Batch Safety Regression Suite
sprints.goal: Continuously prove stale/locked/failing/low-disk destructive operations cannot corrupt or silently alter user files.
tests: Undo conflict does not overwrite newer edit.
acceptance: Runs in release gate.
tasks: Change file after preview then apply.

sprints.title: Public Share Security Audit
sprints.goal: Attack token scope, traversal, membership, XSS/CSP, rate limits, dependency boundary, and revoke behavior.
acceptance: Residual same-user OS risk documented consistently.

sprints.title: Performance Benchmark Gate
sprints.goal: Record and gate practical performance for search/indexing/canvas/graph/PDF merge under target scale.
tests: No O(n²) full scan in measured placement path.
Interactive search remains responsive under write load.
acceptance: Thresholds derive from measured baseline, not invented claims.
tasks: Benchmark warm FTS search during indexing writes.
Benchmark graph neighborhood vs full graph.
Benchmark streaming PDF merge peak memory.
Store baseline results and regression thresholds.

sprints.title: Crash & Interrupted-Operation Recovery
sprints.goal: Verify app/process crashes at critical boundaries do not corrupt source files or leave unrecoverable internal state.
tests: Source file remains valid at every injected crash point.
acceptance: Never infer success from an interrupted operation without verification.
tasks: Crash after atomic replace before history finalization.
Recover/clean orphan temp jobs on startup.

sprints.title: Windows Installer Packaging
sprints.goal: Package the self-contained win-x64 desktop app and ShareHost into a normal Windows installer without bundling user documents.
tests: App starts without dev server/.NET install.
acceptance: Word remains external prerequisite for Word-dependent features.
tasks: Use WiX or chosen full-trust installer.
Verify uninstall never removes source documents.

sprints.title: Release Verification Pipeline
sprints.goal: Create a release gate that runs all safety/security/golden/performance checks before producing final artifacts.
acceptance: No 'green by skipping tests' policy.
tasks: Run Windows Word/COM suite on capable runner.
Attach test summary and checksums to artifacts.

sprints.title: V1 Readiness Gate
sprints.goal: Perform final product/spec coverage review and block V1 if any locked behavior remains unimplemented or unverified.
tests: Every locked requirement maps to implementation evidence.
acceptance: V1 is evidence-based, not feature-count based.
tasks: Map every master-spec locked requirement to sprint/test evidence.
